title: Implement API Authentication and Authorization
problem_statement: Web API endpoints lack authentication mechanisms, creating security vulnerabilities
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to sensitive agent operations and context data
suggested_approach: Implement JWT-based authentication with role-based access control using FastAPI security utilities
success_criteria: All API endpoints require valid authentication
Role-based permissions for different agent operations
Secure token management and refresh mechanisms

title: Establish Comprehensive Test Suite
problem_statement: No test files detected, indicating lack of automated testing coverage
risk_if_unaddressed: Production bugs, regression issues, and difficulty maintaining code quality
suggested_approach: Implement pytest-based test suite with unit tests for agents, integration tests for APIs, and contract tests for schemas
success_criteria: Unit tests for all agent classes

title: Reduce Agent Module Coupling
problem_statement: High import counts in agent modules indicate tight coupling and potential circular dependencies
risk_if_unaddressed: Difficult maintenance, testing challenges, and potential runtime dependency issues
suggested_approach: Implement dependency injection pattern and extract common interfaces to reduce direct imports
success_criteria: Reduce import count per agent module by 50%

title: Implement Production Monitoring and Logging
problem_statement: Missing structured logging, monitoring, and observability for production operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Difficult troubleshooting, no visibility into system health, potential downtime
suggested_approach: Implement structured logging with correlation IDs, health check endpoints, and metrics collection
success_criteria: Structured JSON logging across all components
Health check endpoints for all services

title: Secure Context Vault Operations
problem_statement: Context vault handles sensitive data without visible encryption or security measures
risk_if_unaddressed: Data breaches, compliance violations, unauthorized access to sensitive context data
suggested_approach: Implement encryption at rest and in transit for context data with proper key management
success_criteria: All context data encrypted at rest

provenance.evidence: Context vault operations without encryption patterns
